patterns.note: Sections utilize a full-width dark background with content constrained to a central maximum width, often employing asymmetrical arrangements of text and visual elements.
Key phrases within large, bold headings are highlighted with a vibrant gradient fill, drawing immediate attention to the core value proposition.
A consistent dark mode aesthetic dominates, using deep charcoal and black backgrounds, contrasted with bright, multi-color gradients (purple, pink, teal) for CTAs and emphasized text.

Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience. The navigation bar becomes sticky and gains a subtle background on scroll.
The 'How Qodo Works' section features a unique layered card design that animates to reveal content as the user scrolls, visually representing a process flow.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed sequentially as they enter the viewport, typically with a subtle fade and upward translation, using scroll-triggered animation. The main navigation bar transitions to a sticky position with a semi-transparent dark background once the user scrolls past the initial hero content.
Headings and call-to-action buttons incorporate a vibrant, multi-stop gradient fill that provides a striking visual contrast against the dark backgrounds.
Interactive elements like buttons and cards feature subtle hover effects, such as background color shifts or slight lifts, to indicate interactivity.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels for sub-sections.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (small border-radius) for cards, buttons, and input fields, providing a soft, modern feel without being fully rounded or sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy spacing, particularly in the hero section and between major content blocks, creating a sense of openness. Content within card grids maintains good padding for readability.

standout: The site's distinctive use of vibrant, multi-color gradients for text highlights and CTAs against a sophisticated dark mode background creates a premium and modern aesthetic. The scroll-triggered animations, especially the layered card reveal in the 'How Qodo Works' section, add a unique interactive dimension that elevates the user experience beyond typical marketing sites.
